title: | SABBATH EVENING CLASS: The Third Kingdom of Babylon

sense.text:
“The Lord shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria”: write this down, Assyria is Turkey. You have Israelites in Turkey. “And from Egypt”: lower Egypt is Africa. “And from Pathros”: Pathros is upper Egypt, still in Africa. “And from Cush”: Cush is Ethiopia, that’s Africa. “And from Elam”: that’s India and Iran. “And from Shinar”: Shinar is modern-day Iraq. “And from Hamath”: modern-day Syria.

“And from the islands of the sea”: the islands off the west coast of Africa, Cape Verde, and the Hawaiian islands as well. That’s an example of the islands.

The Bible dictionary on Ham: the youngest son of Noah, born about 96 years before the flood, one of eight persons to live through the flood. He became the progenitor of the dark races, meaning the African races: not the negroes. He did not become the father of the negroes, but of the Egyptians, Ethiopians, Libyans and Canaanites, Genesis 10:6-20. Those are the African nations.

“And the sons of Ham; Cush”: that’s Ethiopia. “And Mizraim”: write that down, Mizraim is Egypt. “And Phut”: north Africa.

When you look at these movies they have the Egyptians or the Ethiopians or the Libyans, and they always show them as Caucasians, and nobody has a problem with that. We have to start making a stink out of the egregious way they portray nations in Hollywood.
“And the sons of Cush”: out of Cush’s line, these are the Ethiopic nations, dark-skinned Africans.

“And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be a mighty one in the earth. He was a mighty hunter before the Lord”: before the Lord means against the Lord. He conquered nations, he conquered the people, and he made them serve him. It doesn’t mean he was a nice guy and he hunted birds. He hunted nations of men; that’s what he did.
“And the beginning of his kingdom was Babel”: that’s Babylon. “In the land of Shinar”: the land of Shinar, that’s modern-day Iraq.

“Unto Shem also, the father of all the children of Eber”: write this down, Eber is where the word Hebrew comes from. Heber means from the past, so when it says Hebrew it means the language from the past.

“The brother of Japheth the elder”: Japheth refers to beautiful; that’s what it means. That’s where you get your Polynesians, your Hawaiians. When you look up Japheth in many history books, they were all brown skin with long wavy hair; those were your Polynesians, your Hawaiians. The Filipinos are more mixed.

The word Shem means name. When you hear Amalek say Hashem will bless you, they’re saying the name, meaning the name of God will bless you. Rather than say Yahawah or Yahweh, they call God’s name Hashem.

Notice who the father is: Shem, the father of all the children of Eber. So what we’re reading are all the Hebrew nations. The white man says the only Hebrew is those in Israel; that’s a lie. This is why they don’t want us on mainstream TV: we will use the Bible and put holes in all their false doctrines. When they say you’re anti-Semitic: we are Shemitic, we come from Shem. Just like Elam, the East Indians, come from Shem. The Arabs come from Abraham; they are Shemitic. That’s what they say: don’t let them Israelites on, put the damn Christians on, put T.D. Jakes, Creflo; they go with our program, but not them dirty black ungodly Israelites.
“The children of Shem; Elam”: Elam are your modern-day East Indians, and the people in Iran. “And Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram.”

“And unto Eber were born two sons”: unto Hebrew were born two sons. “The name of one was Peleg”: that means division, “for in his days was the earth divided”. When Peleg was born, that’s what Genesis 11 goes into.

“And the whole earth was of one language, and of one speech.” One speech means there was no potato, potahto; there was no tomato, tomahto. Everybody had the same language and everybody pronounced the same words the same way. Here we have a form of English, and over in England they got the queen’s English; we got gutter English over here, and the proper English. It ain’t like that here in Genesis 11. Everyone had one language and they spoke every word the same; that’s what it means by one speech.

“Let us build us a city and a tower, whose top may reach unto heaven”: they wanted to build a city, a tower that could reach up to heaven, to God. The pictures of the tower of Babel are only a guess, because it’s been destroyed since then.

“Lest we be scattered abroad upon the face of the whole earth”: remember what had occurred before this time, the flood. They said let’s build a tower that could reach up to heaven, lest we be scattered, meaning killed and destroyed.

“Behold, the people is one”: why? Because Nimrod made everybody united under him. “And they have all one language.”

“And now nothing will be restrained from them, which they have imagined to do”: back then spiritual power was on another level. You see how the white man got his science today: science and magic are very similar. What they called witchcraft back in the day, mystical arts, today they call science. Back then they were able to do certain things that are not accomplished today. Whatever they imagined to do, they were able to accomplish it.

“Go to, let us go down”: this is the angels. “And there confound their language, that they may not understand one another’s speech.” This is where you get the origin of all these different languages in the earth.

“Therefore is the name of it called Babel”: Babel means confusion, the city of confusion, “because the Lord did there confound the language of all the earth: and from thence did the Lord scatter them abroad upon the face of all the earth.” Everybody was scattered; whichever language you spoke, you left with those people. Those that spoke a particular language stayed together because they were able to understand one another.

The history of Nimrod is very limited in the Bible; remember the Bible was burned and destroyed several times. But Esau had their archaeologists and ministers that dug up many archives, and they wrote these things in books, like The Two Babylons, or the Papal Worship Proved to Be the Worship of Nimrod and His Wife, by the late Reverend Alexander Hislop. It shows the origin of many of the Christian holidays, like Easter and Christmas, rooted in paganism. The Babylonians supremely worshiped a goddess mother and a son, and that worship of the mother and child spread to the ends of the earth: in Egypt as Isis and Osiris, in India, in Asia, in pagan Rome, in Greece, even in Tibet, China and Japan. How do all these nations have the same mother and child, goddess and son? It comes from ancient Babylon. When the Lord divided the languages, as we just read in Genesis 11, everybody knew about Nimrod and his mother-wife Semiramis (he’s filthy) and their child Tammuz. When they were scattered abroad according to their language, they took that mythology they learned with them.

Nimrod married his mother, filthy as hell. This was a nasty woman; this woman married her kids. Ninus is sometimes called the husband and sometimes the son of Semiramis, and that is the origin of the same confusion between Isis and Osiris: Osiris was worshiped in Egypt as at once the son and husband of his mother, and bore the title husband of the mother. Egypt picked up the same filth, the same paganism, and the church has it here in America too.

The Babylonian Madonna: remember they call her the virgin. That’s why Christianity says Mary was a virgin, she’s always been a virgin. It all goes back to that nasty Semiramis, who claimed she never had sex and the baby mysteriously appeared. The son born in her arms is Nimrod, Ninus, king of the Assyrians: when you read about the Assyrian empire, they worshiped Ninus, and that’s what they call Nimrod. And they honored Cush as Bel.

This is the mother goddess they were worshiping. Look at Ishtar, Ashtaroth, the fertility goddess with the many breasts: those are the eggs of Easter, that’s where they get all that from. It goes all the way back to Nimrod. See the disc over the head, just like in ancient Egypt: it goes back to ancient Babylon, and Egypt followed it. Type in the goddess Diana and look what pops up: Diana of Ephesus. That’s Acts 19.

precepts.why:

This is why, in many of these Christian holidays, especially among the Catholics, you have many of our brothers and sisters weeping for the baby Jesus. That one lamented, adored as a little child in his mother’s arms, is the same as the mother and child of the Egyptians, the Mary and baby Jesus y’all be seeing. It’s just the same thing.

Look at the pictures side by side: on the left you got Isis and Osiris, then you got so-called Mary and baby Jesus. It’s the same thing, the mother and child worship brought from way back, from Babylon to Egypt to Rome to America today. They always show Christ as a baby; that goes back to Tammuz.

“Thy terribleness hath deceived thee, and the pride of thine heart, O thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, that holdest the height of the hill”. The clefts of the rock goes back to the term Caucasian, which comes from the Caucasus mountains of Georgia, Russia.

“Though thou shouldest make thy nest as high as the eagle, I will bring thee down from thence, saith the Lord.” In verse 16 Jeremiah is talking about Neo-Babylon under Nebuchadnezzar, and then in verse 17 he goes into Edom. That is why the class came here.

“Also Edom shall be a desolation: every one that goeth by it shall be astonished, and shall hiss at all the plagues thereof.” Edom shall be destroyed. That is what Revelation 18 was talking about with the plagues; it is saying the same thing.

“As in the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah”: how were Sodom and Gomorrah overthrown? Through thermonuclear destruction. And why does it say as Sodom and Gomorrah? Remember Revelation 11:8, read earlier in the class: Babylon the great is spiritually called Sodom and Egypt. So he is comparing Sodom with Edom, with Babylon.

“No man shall abide there”: this place is going to be destroyed.

precepts.why:
“And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms”: that is why it is called Babylon the great. This place is the glory of all kingdoms right now. Everybody wants to come to America; nobody is rushing to go to Africa. The nations are rushing to come here. “The beauty of the Chaldees’ excellency, shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah”, the same overthrow Jeremiah spoke of over Edom.

“It shall never be inhabited”: this place shall never be inhabited. That is how you know it is not talking about Iraq, as the Christians say. Do people live in Iraq today? Yes. So this is this place right here. “Neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation: neither shall the Arabian pitch tent there; neither shall the shepherds make their fold there.”

sense.text:
The preacher who tried to say the deacon was wrong doesn’t know what the hell he is talking about. This proves that the Babylon the great he was talking about is right where we are sitting, in the United States of America. This is Babylon the great, spiritually called Sodom and Egypt.

“And the kings of the earth, who have committed fornication and lived deliciously with her”: fornication, when you look it up, is talking about sex, but it can’t be literal sex, because England is not jumping over here having sex with America like that. It has a spiritual meaning. Lived deliciously goes to wealth: trade and commerce policies that allow nations to become wealthy.

They “shall bewail her, and lament for her, when they shall see the smoke of her burning”, the smoke of Babylon’s burning.
“Standing afar off for the fear of her torment”, they will stand afar off. “For in one hour is thy judgment come”: it is going to take God one hour to destroy this place. One hour, that’s it.

“The merchants of the earth shall weep and mourn over her; for no man buyeth their merchandise any more”. America does business with all these various nations, like buying the chips China makes for cars and key fobs, and now they say a lot of that can’t be made because they have a problem with China. These nations get wealthy trading with America, and that is why the nations don’t really speak against her.

“Take up this proverb against the king of Babylon, and say, How hath the oppressor ceased! the golden city ceased!” This is saying the same thing Revelation 18 was saying. It says golden city because this is the richest kingdom on earth.
“The Lord hath broken the staff of the wicked, and the sceptre of the rulers”: he is going to break the power of this place, America.

“He who smote the people in wrath with a continual stroke”: America smites the people with wrath, with a continual stroke. They don’t stop, they don’t let up. “He that ruled the nations in anger”: America is the one that rules the nations in anger. “Is persecuted”: America is going to be persecuted. “And none hindereth”: nobody is going to be able to stop the persecution that comes here.

“The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet”: listen good, when this place is destroyed the whole earth is at rest. “They break forth into singing”: hallelujah, hallelujah. Everybody is going to rejoice when this place is destroyed. That is the prophecy, and it is saying the same thing as 2 Esdras 11.

“Yea, the fir trees rejoice at thee, and the cedars of Lebanon”: God is telling you there are spirits in trees that are going to rejoice at the fall of Babylon. “Since thou art laid down, no feller is come up against us.”

precepts.why:
“And therefore appear no more, thou eagle”: the eagle is America, the white man. “Nor thy horrible wings”: your allies. “Nor thy wicked feathers”: your leaders. “Nor thy malicious heads, nor thy hurtful claws”: the hurtful claws are your military. “Nor all thy vain body”: their vain body is their Edomite citizens.

“That all the earth may be refreshed”: that is what Isaiah said, the whole earth at rest and quiet. “And may return, being delivered from thy violence, and that she may hope for the judgment and mercy of him that made her.” When the eagle is gone, the earth is delivered from America’s violence and breaks forth into singing. That’s some bad stuff right there.

sense.text:
“How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer”: remember, Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen. This is saying the same thing, but now it calls Babylon the great Lucifer. Why? Because Lucifer means day star, or light bearer. Look at the Statue of Liberty: she is holding up a torch, bearing a light to the nations. That is why they keep that thing polished, because it represents the torch by which she bears forth wisdom and knowledge to all nations: bring your tired, your poor, your huddled masses. America is the light bearer to all nations, the day star nation.

“Son of the morning! how art thou cut down to the ground, which didst weaken the nations!” How are you destroyed? Because you destroyed the nations.

Isaiah is giving the example of Babylon the great, Lucifer. “I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of God”: that is space travel. America is doing it; you have Elon Musk, you have the man from Virgin. Is Iraq up there? Iraq ain’t doing this. Stop listening to stupid Christians. They are dumb until they repent. Don’t listen to anything they say; they don’t know the bible. This is Babylon, Lucifer.

“I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation”: the mount of the congregation is Mount Zion, Israel. That is talking about slavery. To sit on somebody means you conquered them, you overthrew them, you beat them, you rule them, you reign over them, you wasted them. That is them sitting on us.

“In the sides of the north”: north America, the same north Zechariah spoke of.

“I will ascend above the heights of the clouds”: the Wright brothers invented the first airplane, and from the old models to the new, the planes go above the heights of the clouds.

“I will be like the most High”: that goes into them representing themselves as God and Christ, like the Sistine Chapel.
“Yet thou shalt be brought down to hell, to the sides of the pit.”

“They that see thee shall narrowly look upon thee, and consider thee, saying, Is this the man”. The man. Christians say Lucifer is a spiritual demon, and you tear them up with this verse right here. You have to stress it with Christians, because they have a spell of witchcraft on them: no, Lucifer is not a spiritual demon, the bible says the man.

What is going to cause him to be narrowly looked upon is the scripture in Thessalonians, ‘then shall that wicked be revealed’. The scales are going to come off because this bible is going to reveal him, and the people will say, you are the devil, because the wicked is being revealed. That is the real fight behind the scenes for Christianity: they don’t want this truth to get out, because they need people to stay stupid.

“That made the earth to tremble, that did shake kingdoms”.

“That made the world as a wilderness, and destroyed the cities thereof”: who is destroying the cities? It is not a spirit coming down saying drop a bomb. That is the white man dropping bombs, America dropping bombs. “That opened not the house of his prisoners”: we are his prisoners, and he didn’t open his house to us.
“All the kings of the nations, even all of them, lie in glory”: they lie in wait, every one in his own house, waiting for the opportunity to rule.

“But thou art cast out of thy grave like an abominable branch”: the white man is going to be cast out of his grave like an abominable branch, “as the raiment of those that are slain, thrust through with a sword, that go down to the stones of the pit; as a carcase trodden under feet.”

When he is cast out, he is not going to get the first plate of food. When Christ comes in for war, we are going to get it. That will be a different deal; the nations are going to look at us differently and say, you deserve to eat.

“Thou shalt not be joined with them in burial”: the white man is not going to be joined with the other nations in burial. “Because thou hast destroyed thy land”: this land that they stole, they are destroying with their nuclear fallouts and their chemical spills; they are the ones with what they call global warming. “And slain thy people”.

“The seed of evildoers”: seed means generations, generations of evildoers, not one man. Some might say verse 16 says the man, singular, but in case that wasn’t good enough, God clears it up: the seed of evildoers, plural. They “shall never be renowned”: they are never going to be famous in the earth again.

“Prepare slaughter for his children”: God explains the seed of evildoers. That means Becky, Miss Laura, Karen too, your friends at work that you just like because they’re nice. God says he is preparing slaughter for them. This isn’t talking about spirits; spirits don’t have children, and you can’t slaughter a spirit.

“For the iniquity of their fathers”: white folks say, that wasn’t me, I didn’t have you in slavery, that was my fathers, I just reap the benefits, I’m innocent. God says he prepares slaughter for the children for the sins of their fathers.

“That they do not rise, nor possess the land, nor fill the face of the world with cities”: London is not going to come around anymore, France either, America definitely not. All the cities they built will be gone. You want bible? We’re giving you bible, but you can’t handle the truth.

“For I will rise up against them, saith the Lord of hosts, and cut off from Babylon the name, and remnant, and son, and nephew”. Why does it say son and nephew? Because they carry the seed. Those are males, and God is going to get rid of all of them.
“I will sweep it with the besom of destruction, saith the Lord of hosts.” Total annihilation, total destruction; nobody is going to survive the besom of destruction.
“The Lord of hosts hath sworn, saying, Surely as I have thought, so shall it come to pass; and as I have purposed, so shall it stand”.

“That I will break the Assyrian in my land”: the Assyrian in God’s land is Amalek, the so-called Jewish people. “And upon my mountains tread him under foot”: they are going to be destroyed. “Then shall his yoke depart from off them, and his burden depart from off their shoulders.”

“This is the purpose that is purposed upon the whole earth”: God’s purpose is not only to destroy Babylon. He says, I am going to wipe the Assyrians out of my land, those white folks that took my land over. “This is the hand that is stretched out upon all the nations.”

“For the Lord of hosts hath purposed, and who shall disannul it?” God has purposed to destroy America, Babylon the great, and the white man in Israel today. Who can change the plot, the program and the plan of God? Nobody. “And his hand is stretched out, and who shall turn it back?” Who is going to turn God’s hand back?
“In the year that king Ahaz died was this burden.” That is the year Isaiah saw this vision.

“Rejoice not thou, whole Palestina”: you Palestinians might rejoice because God destroyed these Assyrians in his land, the so-called Jewish people. “Because the rod of him that smote thee is broken”: the ones that smote thee, these white people that beat the Palestinians. He says, don’t rejoice just yet.

“For out of the serpent’s root shall come forth a cockatrice, and his fruit shall be a fiery flying serpent”: that is what the bible is talking about, a missile launching out of a silo. A fiery flying serpent is an ICBM, an intercontinental ballistic missile.

“And the firstborn of the poor shall feed, and the needy shall lie down in safety”: we are the firstborn of the poor, we are the needy. When America and the land of Israel and Palestine are wiped out, at that time we are going to lie down in safety.

“I will kill thy root with famine, and he shall slay thy remnant”: that is what was read in verse 21 about preparing slaughter for his children.

“Howl, O gate; cry, O city; thou, whole Palestina, art dissolved”: you are destroyed too. You thought I was just getting the Assyrian in my land? No, I’m getting you too. That is why we have to be on God’s side. People argue over who is on the Palestinian side and who is on the Israeli side; we are on none of their sides. We are on God’s side, and God said both of them are going to be destroyed.

“For there shall come from the north a smoke”: from north America, a smoke of destruction. “And none shall be alone in his appointed times”: when America shoots that missile to destroy Palestine, a whole lot of America is being destroyed too, and Jeremiah goes into that.

“What shall one then answer the messengers of the nation? That the Lord hath founded Zion”: he founded us. “And the poor of his people shall trust in it”: we are the poor of his people. So brothers and sisters, never give up.

precepts.why:
Here is a precept for the mount of the congregation: “Remember thy congregation, which thou hast purchased of old; the rod of thine inheritance, which thou hast redeemed; this mount Zion, wherein thou hast dwelt.” So Mount Zion is the congregation of the Lord, which is another name for Israel.

When Lucifer says “I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation”, he is sitting on Israel: that is slavery, Babylon the great conquering and ruling over God’s people.

The sides of the north was just read in Zechariah. “Deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon.” And the verse before: “Ho, ho, come forth, and flee from the land of the north, saith the Lord: for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the heaven, saith the Lord.”

Zion, Israel, dwells with the daughter of Babylon, and God tells Zion to flee from the land of the north. He is telling you the daughter of Babylon would be in the north: North America. So when Lucifer sits upon the mount of the congregation “in the sides of the north”, that is North America sitting on Israel.

“Is this the man” brought this to mind: “Here is wisdom. Let him that hath understanding count the number of the beast: for it is the number of a man”. A man. It is the same man being read about in Isaiah 14.

Stop looking for some fifth-dimensional spirit to come down. It is talking about the white man. The beast and Lucifer are not a spiritual demon but a man, the white man.
